meaning.en: final freedom, aloneness of the Self
whose nature is the self-light of one's own Self
in the form of a living being
by the fruits of merit and sin
meaning.hi: पुण्य और पाप के फलों से

meaning.en: the state of the supreme Self
the condition of a living being

meaning.hi: सभी भावों और अवस्थाओं से परे

meaning.en: made of the qualities of nature
by the idea of being a living creature
desire, anger, fear and the rest
the form of one's own Self
of faults such as desire and anger
free from the confusion of worldly life
in the form of a pulse
the state of wandering in worldly life
in delusions of pleasure, pain and the rest
is known to be like this
one who has mastered the senses
by the yoga of the body

meaning.hi: दूसरी चीज़ों से पीड़ित होता है

meaning.en: by pleasure, pain and the like
by weapons, fire, water and wind
meaning.hi: शस्त्र, अग्नि, जल और वायु से

meaning.en: at the time of the body's end
at the end of the body
water, fire, weapons, pits and so on
there is none at all for him
moon and sun, the two side channels
in the form of highest space
there is truly none for him
of the downward and upward breaths
of one's female and male essences
of the individual and supreme Self
on the tip of the nose
at the three times of day
by the favour of the teacher's cloth
the marks of the wrapping cloth
by the technique of stirring the power
even of one in death's wheel
inside the opening of the central channel

meaning.hi: केवल कुम्भक की प्राप्ति कराने वाला

meaning.en: in the form of the breath and its currents
removing the disease of worldly life
should exhale through the left channel

meaning.hi: नाड़ियों के जल को हटाने वाला

meaning.en: destroying faults lodged in the tissues
meaning.hi: धातुओं में स्थित दोषों का नाशक

meaning.en: when fatigue arises in the body
should fill through the sun channel

meaning.hi: मुख के दोष नष्ट करने वाला

meaning.en: lying inside the mouth of the central channel
the bolt of phlegm and the like
at the end of the in-breath
in the form of throat contraction
when the throat contraction is made
going into the channel of Brahman
to what has the nature of Shiva
in the union of Shiva and Shakti
by the diamond tube of the central channel
having the form of the universe
through the binding of moon and sun
the mark of the western door
those who await the body's fall
the ceasing of the breath too
but if it is not so
which is being, awareness and bliss
when the yoga of absorption has dawned
the bliss of one's own Self
in the middle of the womb-place
red like hibiscus and bandhuka flowers
meaning.hi: जपा और बन्धूक के समान लाल

meaning.en: of the feminine essence and masculine seed
the state of powers such as minuteness
the union of the upward and downward breaths
by the path of the western door
from practice done in a former life
anything other than the crow's way
through the stages of hatha yoga
dissolution of the self and so on
the dullness born of the body

meaning.hi: इच्छा से रूप धारण करने वाला

meaning.en: from the means of spells, practices and so on
in those wholly devoted to union with the Self
and in those free of cravings
in the state of the supreme Self
in one free of gain and loss
whose body is unageing and undying
cattle, chickens, insects and the rest
by the falling of the body
like the state of a bubble
with ten channels as its highways
with six supporting centres as inner rooms
meaning.hi: छह आधार रूपी भीतरी कक्षों वाला

meaning.en: with six lineages as a great forest
laid out with four sacred seats
whose great emblem is drop and sound
the dwelling of Shiva and Shakti
between the anus and the genitals
meaning.hi: गुदा और लिंग के बीच स्थित

meaning.en: in the form of the individual soul
at the base of the genitals
in the hollow of the throat
in the form of inner sound
or because I preside in it
because it is the emblem of the root nature
meaning.hi: मूल स्वरूप का लिंग होने से

meaning.en: and because of being the cause
in the form of the vital drop
in the form of the sacred seat
the seat of the vital drop
and by closing the six openings
by the path of the teacher's instruction
made of the five aspects of Brahman
marked by being, awareness and bliss
beyond the range of speech and mind
mantra higher than the inner sound
by one always wishing for attainment
these truths that have been told
as Brahman in the form of sound
in the form of the vital drop
her as Pashyanti, the seeing one
in the form of branches and shoots
of Vedas, sacred sciences and Puranas
the point and the inner sound
not an object to aim at
not able to be pointed out

meaning.hi: आँख, कान और नाम से रहित

meaning.en: as taking it for a snake
alone, in the form of the universe
between the individual and supreme Self
the mistaken notion of a pot
in the Self that is awareness
a city of the celestial musicians

meaning.hi: लहरों और तरंगों के रूप में

meaning.en: for the knower and the unknowing
the point and the inner sound
granting attainment to all embodied beings
meaning.hi: सब देहधारियों को सिद्धि देने वाला

meaning.en: in the form of the soul
at the root of the sexual organ
in the hollow of the throat
the form of the goddess's power
having the form of inner sound
to the tip of the tongue
in the form of five fires
of the nature of the inner self
at the root of the palate
into the hollow of the skull
in the space before and beyond
at the point twelve finger-widths above
seated at the heart of a lotus
I shall tell of the attainments
of those who have mastered the senses
in the Self that is Time
becoming minute and the other powers
he who has known the truth
to her who is beyond the mind
the others lead every way at departure
meaning.hi: बाकी निकलते समय सब ओर जाती हैं

meaning.en: is held to be the highest
free of the dust of passion
having the nature of the sun
sacred sciences, learning, arts and letters
through knowledge of the upward way
at the place of the moon
in the cage of the body
at the root of the palate
leaves the wandering of worldly life
yet free of going and the rest
the form of the supreme Self
by the awakening of the power
by the splendour of the root wheel
by holding the breath at the base
by holding the breath at the base
in the base are all the gods
in the base are all the Vedas
should take shelter in the base
from the bonds of worldly existence
at the rear of the base
at the rear of the base
he is a knower of yoga
in the Ganga and the ocean
the highest repetition of the name
at the front of the forehead
in the lotus of the inner sky
in the middle of the forehead
the power made of the Bindu
along the left and right paths
knocked about by the two breaths
the wise one who knows that
he is a knower of yoga
by attending to the inner sound
